messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for service `inference-runtime`
Environment: production (us-west-2)
Version: v1.9.2-tag-rc3 (tag: v1.9.2-rc3)
Commit: a1b2c3d4
Traffic plan: start 5% for 15m -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%
Change window: 2025-11-03T22:00Z - 2025-11-04T02:00Z
Notes: kernel scheduling + kv-cache bump. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1423 :rocket:

sylvia: smoke tests queued, will watch tail of logs and latency dashboards :eyes:

mike: pinned canary baseline at 5% while we observe. If errors > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms we hold/rollback

release-triage-bot: Added pin: canary_group=inference-runtime-canary-2250004321, reason=auto-pin-on-start

canary-watcher-bot: [t+5m] quick check: p50=98ms, p95=210ms, errors=0.12% — passing thresholds :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rolling to 25% in 10m as scheduled (no holds)

sylvia: good to proceed, watching for any KV-cache churn

canary-watcher-bot: [t+25m] mid-check: p50=110ms, p95=240ms, errors=0.62% — error rate exceeded 0.5% threshold :warning:

mike: I see a correlated spike in quantized-path exceptions — tailing logs: ```ERROR inference::quant::fallback failed for shard=3```

jen: recommend pin at current 25% and start mitigation. If rollback easy, prefer rollback of the quantization change for canary variant.

release-triage-bot: Pinning traffic at 25% and pausing automatic ramp. Notifying oncall.

mike: I'll trigger a targeted rollback for the canary variant to v1.9.1-quant-fix (keeps other infra untouched)

deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for inference-runtime canary_group=inference-runtime-canary-2250004321 -> target version v1.9.1-quant-fix

canary-watcher-bot: smoke run after rollback: p50=95ms, p95=200ms, errors=0.08% — smoke OK :white_check_mark:

sylvia: looks stable now, logs are clean.

mike: will hold at 25% for 10m of stable metrics then plan promotion to 100% (skip intermediate 50% to limit exposure)

canary-watcher-bot: [t+55m] stability window OK: p50=92ms, p95=190ms, errors=0.05%

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% scheduled in 10m per oncall approval. Release notes draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/releases/tag/v1.9.2

sylvia: :thumbsup: promote when green

deploy-bot: Canary promotion started -> ramping traffic to 100% using strategy `fast-fanout`

canary-watcher-bot: final checks during promotion: p50 ~94ms, p95 ~205ms, errors ~0.07% — within SLOs :heavy_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary promotion complete. inference-runtime v1.9.1-quant-fix deployed to production (all regions). Full rollout finished at 2025-11-03T23:12:03Z.

deploy-bot: Release notes: https://github.com/redwood/inference/releases/tag/v1.9.2 (summary: kv-cache improvements, revert quantization fallback change for stability)

sylvia: nice work team, logging follow-up issue #1540 to track long-term quantization fix

mike: created issue #1540 and scheduled a postmortem spike in next sprint :calendar:

release-triage-bot: Closing rollout ticket: RL-2025-317. All alerts cleared.
